# JNJ — Catalysts

## TL;DR

The BofA Healthcare Conference on May 12 (~5 trading days from May 6) is the primary live risk event for the active short (id 116, 3 shares). Positive pipeline commentary — especially on IMAAVY (nipocalimab) for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia/myasthenia gravis or Darzalex trajectory — could trigger short-covering from deeply oversold levels (RSI-14 31.16). New bear signal: JNJ's IBD therapy trial failed to show statistically meaningful improvement over placebo (STAT News, May 5, 2026) — a pipeline miss that strengthens the structural headwind. Bull offset: Ottava robotic surgery system met primary endpoints in gastric bypass study (FDA approval expected 2026). Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 14) is fully absorbed. The macro backdrop — strongly risk-on (S&P 500 ATH 7,338.89 May 6) with capital rotating into AI/growth/tech and out of defensive healthcare — remains the regime tailwind for the short. No insider buying at multi-week lows. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260506_194605.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| BofA Healthcare Conference | May 12, 2026 | PRIMARY WATCH — IMAAVY and Darzalex guidance; positive commentary triggers short-covering risk |
| Quarterly dividend ex-date | May 26, 2026 | $1.34/share declared (64th consecutive annual increase); income signal, not a price mover |
| RBC Capital Markets Global Healthcare Conference | May 19, 2026 | Second near-term appearance — additional pipeline commentary risk |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 15–22, 2026 | Next binary — analyst Q2 EPS est. ~$2.84; Darzalex growth vs Stelara erosion rate is key read |
| IMAAVY FDA review decision | TBD (Priority Review granted) | Priority Review for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia; Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 positive for myasthenia gravis (AAN 2026) |
| Ottava robotic surgery FDA | 2026 (expected) | Met primary endpoints in gastric bypass study — near-term pipeline positive |
| Talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) | Unscheduled | Largest unquantifiable binary — settlement or adverse ruling creates a gap |

## Recent news synthesis

**IBD therapy trial failure (May 5, 2026) — new bear signal.** STAT News reported JNJ's IBD therapy trial failed to show statistically meaningful improvement over placebo. Pipeline miss in a competitive $20B IBD combination therapy market where AbbVie, Pfizer, Merck, Lilly, and JNJ are all competing. Directionally consistent with the short thesis. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260506_194605.)

**Ottava robotic surgery positive (May 5, 2026).** JNJ's Ottava system met primary endpoints in a gastric bypass clinical study — FDA approval expected in 2026. A structural pipeline positive, but not a near-term price driver. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260506_194605.)

**Macro strongly risk-on (May 6, 2026).** S&P 500 closed at ATH 7,338.89 (+1.10%), Nasdaq at 25,670 (+1.36%). Risk-on growth rotation out of defensive healthcare (JNJ/XLV) into AI/tech/cyclicals is the dominant macro force. JNJ has underperformed by ~6.4% over 21 days while the S&P gained. This remains a macro tailwind for the short thesis. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json macro_context, run 20260506_194605.)

**Q1 2026 earnings (April 14) — fully absorbed.** Revenue $24.1B (+10% YoY, beat $23.6B est); adj. EPS $2.70 (beat $2.67); Darzalex $4B (beat $3.4B est); Tremfya $1.6B (beat $1.2B est); GAAP net income fell 52.4% on talc reserve. Full-year guidance raised (adj. EPS $11.55, sales midpoint $100.8B). Muted +0.5-1% price reaction confirmed trapped-longs absorption. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260506_194605.)

**Stelara biosimilar erosion — ongoing headwind.** AbbVie and Amgen biosimilar launches continue to erode Stelara revenues. Royalty Pharma $500M Icotyde partnership is the recovery vehicle. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260506_194605.)

## Analyst consensus

Avg PT ~$249.00 (range $153–$280; 19-23 analysts Buy as of April 2026). Morgan Stanley raised PT to $262 (January 28); Barclays, Stifel, Wells Fargo all ~$256 (April 15, 2026). Price ~$224.28 is ~10%+ below consensus — implied upside, but the confirmed downtrend and IBD trial failure reflect short-term institutional disagreement with near-term timing. (Source: analyst_consensus, web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260506_194605.)

## Insider activity

No activity recorded across all recent runs. Absence of insider buying at a multi-week low is a mild bear signal — insiders are not stepping in to defend the stock. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent, signals_combined.json, run 20260506_194605.)

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
2026-05-06 | GOOG | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$6.50 | Mean-reversion short (RSI-7 90.69, Z-score 2.56) stopped at $389.50 as ADX 74.23 extreme trend absorbed the fade; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime repeated the NVDA/AMZN pattern — ADX 60+ environments make fading overbought conditions highly unreliable; strongly risk-on macro (S&P ATH, US-Iran MOU) added upside momentum.
2026-05-06 | AMD | statistical exhaustion short | OUTCOME: -$17.82 | Mean-reversion short (Z-score 2.6, RSI 83, +74% 21d surge) gap-stopped at $372.31 when Q1 2026 earnings blowout (+38% YoY, EPS +43%) gapped AMD +15% overnight; swing_mean_reversion and swing_catalyst_news recommended the fade but earnings binary created a non-linear gap-through-stop outcome; half-sizing to 1 share limited damage to -$17.82 vs -$35.64.
